expectations.text: The report explicitly rejects line-count or metric-only simplification.
expectations.evidence: The report explicitly says no line-count reduction is proposed and treats metrics as subordinate to purpose, cost, and contract.

expectations.text: The report records observed behavior, purpose, cost, counter-evidence, confidence, and impact.
expectations.evidence: The candidate sections contain each requested evidence category.

expectations.text: The report remains read-only and stops at one candidate for a human decision.
expectations.evidence: The report states no files were edited and ends after the first candidate question.

expectations.text: The report offers Keep, Simplify, Defer, and Escalate as the human decisions.
expectations.evidence: The first decision question lists all four states.
